unit.why: A single narrative: two Chabad scholars spend Shabbat with R. Aharon of Karlin, look down on his simple conduct, and he rebukes them with a midrash and a homily on Joseph speaking in the holy tongue.
unit.boundary_note: The final word 'כשנסתלק' is a catchword that opens the next division's eulogy story.

stories.start_quote: פ״א הי׳ אצלו על ש"ק שני ת"ח
stories.summary_en: Two disciples of R. Shneur Zalman spend Shabbat with R. Aharon of Karlin and, seeing no esoteric teachings, think little of him. Sensing this, he grows angry, shows them a midrash they did not know, predicts their mockery of his eating, drinking and speaking in vernacular, and explains through Joseph's words that a holy tongue may speak any language on Shabbat.

tags.why: The whole episode happens at the Shabbat meals.
Chabad hasidim interact with the Karlin tsaddik.

quotes: שני ת"ח מתלמידי הגאון רש"ז בעל התניא

tags.why: The tsaddik is angered by their disdain.

quotes: אני יודע בכם בשתבואו למדינתכם תספרו
tags.why: He knows their unspoken thoughts and what they will say.

quotes: דרכו בקודש היה להיות הצגע לכת והכל בהסתר גדול
tags.why: The tsaddik's modest, concealed conduct is the point of contrast.

quotes: ילא היה להם שום הכנעה לפניו
